notes.title: Update v1.1
notes.content:
Attack Power / Spell Power
Attack Power and Spell Power now increase damage as a percentage rather than as a direct damage value. This was done to improve damage scaling as the game progresses.

New Attribute: Wisdom
Wisdom has been added as a new primary attribute.  It grants a percent bonus to experience earned.

Guard Quirks (Credit: Joetheloser via the discussion board)
Guards now come with 2 random "quirks".  These can be simple attribute boosts, bonuses to certain types of damage/weapons, and more.  There are currently 72 unique Quirks.

Guard Recruiting
Rather than guards being automatically assigned, you now have the ability to choose from generated options.

Guard Injuries (Credit: Joetheloser via the discussion board)
Whenever a guard is downed in combat, there is now a chance they will sustain an injury.  Injuries can last up to a few days or be permanent and will require attention from Hilda the Healer.

New Vendor: Hilda the Healer
Hilda is the settlement's resident healer.  For a bit of coin she can resolve injuries a small as a Concussion all the way up to regrowing severed limbs.

Game Difficulty (Credit: Joetheloser via the discussion board)
At the start of each game, you can now choose a difficulty.  Difficulty effects enemy health/damage and adjusts the base chance of injury when a guard is downed.  There is also an option to enable Permadeath which will automatically remove downed guards from your party.

Other Minor Improvements

 Items now buy/sell for the same amount
 You can now position guards directly on the combat grid rather than through the UI
 Adjustments to item prices
 Adjustments to enemy health/damage
 Added Counter Attack as a Level 20 Feat

notes.title: Minor UI Updates
notes.content:
Added camera control UI widget
Updated combat encounter widget to default to auto-battle mode
